name: Lady Sarevess
summary: Lady Sarevess is a twisted naga sorceress dwelling within the flooded ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, where she dabbles in dark sorceries.

sections.title: A Grotto in the Deeps
sections.body: Within the Pool of Ask'ar, Lady Sarevess conducts her rituals in a flooded grotto of the ruined temple. A very twisted spellcaster, she dabbles in dark magic while the Twilight's Hammer cultists who also haunt the sunken temple pursue their own worship deeper in the cavern.

sections.title: Sorcery of the Tides
sections.body: Much like a sea witch of the deep oceans, Sarevess commands elemental currents and crackling arcs of lightning. Surrounded by loyal naga sentinels and summoned water elementals, she fiercely defends her sanctuary against any intruders who threaten her dark work.

faq.answer: Lady Sarevess is a naga spellcaster who has taken up residence within the subterranean Pool of Ask'ar inside Blackfathom Deeps. She is a very twisted spellcaster who dabbles in dark magic.

faq.q: Where can Lady Sarevess be found?
faq.answer: She makes her lair in the Pool of Ask'ar, a flooded chamber situated in the early reaches of the Blackfathom Deeps temple complex along the Ashenvale coast.

faq.q: What powers does Lady Sarevess command?
faq.answer: Drawing upon the traditions of naga sea witches, Sarevess wields powerful water and elemental magic, particularly violent bursts of forked lightning, to strike down anyone who enters her cove.

angles.text: The ruins Lady Sarevess inhabits were once a sacred temple of Elune. Seeing her twisted naga kin defile the waters of Ask'ar is a bitter reminder of the Sundering.
Sarevess demonstrates how highborne magical practices degenerated into raw, chaotic lightning and tidal sorcery under centuries of oceanic corruption.
